mission: Connect Christian television, Gospel radio, digital radio, podcasts, ministries, artists, churches and distribution partners into a lawful global Gospel media ecosystem.
principle: AFRICAN ORIGIN → IZAKHONO CONTROL → WORLDWIDE DISTRIBUTION
radio_role: Radio is a first-class distribution and acquisition channel alongside television.
territory_strategy: Country-by-country and territory-by-territory acquisition, with rights and regulatory review before distribution.
rights_rule: A radio partnership or stream listing does not itself grant YHVH rights to rebroadcast third-party programming.
editorial_rule: Commercial participation, carriage, sponsorship or partnership does not buy editorial approval or guaranteed airtime.

initial_research_signal.observed_scale: Thousands of Christian radio listings and hundreds of Gospel FM listings across multiple continents.
initial_research_signal.note: Directory listings are discovery leads only; each station must be independently verified before outreach, rights decisions or commercial claims.

next_action: Populate the verified global radio partner registry, prioritise high-fit Gospel networks and stations, prepare partnership outreach, and connect approved radio feeds to YHVH distribution without bypassing rights or local law.
